purpose: Original distinct in-world cyberpunk voxel advertisements

prompts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: a complete original in-world advertising poster texture for a detailed cyberpunk voxel game. Portrait 2:3 full-bleed flat front-on artwork. Brand KURO OPTICS, exact large headline "SEE BEYOND". Subject: a huge intricate mechanical cybernetic eyeball floating over a black titanium armored hand, concentric gold optical lenses, tiny electric lime voxel diodes, precision cubic engineering. Art direction: premium three-dimensional Blender voxel render with very fine crisp cubes, dystopian cyberpunk corporate advertising, midnight black and acid lime/chartreuse with restrained ivory type. Bold asymmetric typographic hierarchy, tiny decorative interface rules and eye diagrams. Strong memorable silhouette readable at distance. Add small line "KURO OPTICS" at bottom, no other readable text needed. No woman or human face, no environment, no city, no mockup, no frame, no watermark. This is the advertisement itself, edge to edge.
